collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — ROLE MODELS AND GOOD EXAMPLES, RM-41 to RM-90 (draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Fifty more events continuing your "Role Models and Good Examples — 40 Events". Same shape as yours: a SETUP, choices A-D (a few have three), and two possible outcomes per choice; the game picks one outcome from the chosen choice.

ledger.why: the owner (2026-11-15): the person the event is about is a cast villager shown by name, the role word kept as flavor (the villager need not have that job)

collection.description: A teacher notices that one child cannot sit still during counting lessons but remembers everything said while walking.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (Name1), a teacher, notices that one child cannot sit still during counting lessons but remembers everything said while walking.

choices.label: Let the Child Stand or Pace at the Back.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: The child learns quickly, and several others enjoy the change too.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: Some children prefer sitting, so the teacher alternates days.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: The child pays more attention, and nobody minds.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: The pacing distracts one other student, and they find a spot where both are comfortable.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: Counting shells, trees and birds makes the lesson lively for everyone.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: The children get distracted by the shells themselves, and the lesson turns into collecting.

d1.name: Outcome D1
d1.text: The child suggests tapping a rhythm, and it works surprisingly well.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: The child is not sure, so they try several ideas over the following days.
